model_output.verdict: A customer success manager with a defined account book and a few unanswered questions about renewals and escalations.
write_up: Your resume tells a clear story from insurance coordination to payroll support and customer success at Brightline. A recruiter can see the accounts you manage and the people you work with, so this is likely to move forward with a few questions. The main missing piece is what happened after your work on renewals and payroll escalations.
The onboarding checklist is a strong model: you built something the whole CS team now uses. Your experience also leads the resume, and the move from support to customer success is easy to follow.
Let's start with the at-risk renewals, then add what you did when payroll runs failed. Keep the account count and the checklist prominent; they give a recruiter a concrete picture of your work.
